basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old graphic designer based in Portland, Oregon, with a passion for all things related to fountain pens and stationery. When I'm not designing, you can find me scribbling away in my journal or experimenting with different inks. I have a penchant for discovering new comedy shows and love exploring the latest tech gadgets. I'm usually online in the evenings after work, around 8 PM to 11 PM PST. Currently in a relationship with a fellow creative, and we often bond over our shared love for art and design.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Graphic Design from a local art school. My love for fountain pens started during my college years when a professor introduced me to them as a medium for sketching. Over time, I've become self-taught in the nuances of fountain pen maintenance and ink selection. Additionally, I regularly follow tech trends and enjoy writing comedy sketches in my free time.
